kpis.name: S&P 500
kpis.note: Broad equity risk-on/risk-off signal. High VIX or S&P drawdown signals demand risk for Southwire construction end markets.

kpis.name: Brent Crude
kpis.note: Energy costs affect Southwire manufacturing and logistics. Sustained Brent >$90 pressures freight and resin input costs.

kpis.name: Copper (LME)
kpis.note: Primary raw material. Copper content of wire drives COGS. Sustained elevation compresses margin unless hedged or repriced.

kpis.name: Aluminum (LME)
kpis.note: Key input for aluminum wire and cable. Price signals secondary cost pressure and hedge calendar triggers.

kpis.name: Freight (Drewry WCI)
kpis.note: Ocean freight index drives import costs on raw materials and packaging. WCI >$4K signals elevated supply chain risk.
kpis.change: Monitor Drewry WCI weekly for rate momentum

kpis.name: VIX
kpis.note: Equity market fear gauge. VIX >25 indicates risk-off environment; monitor customer demand signals and receivables.

kpis.name: Natural Gas
kpis.note: Energy input for manufacturing and logistics. Sustained elevation pressures margin. Drives residential heating demand indirectly.

kpis.name: Gold
kpis.note: Risk sentiment indicator. Gold >$3,000 with VIX elevation signals macro uncertainty that may dampen CapEx spending by customers.

wire.title: How Trump made an estimated $2.2 billion during the first year of his second term
wire.summary: New York Times reporter Eric Lipton discusses his Pulitzer Prize-winning investigations into Trump's conflicts of interest and whether he's exploiting the power of the presidency for self-enrichment.

wire.title: Judge reluctantly dismisses case against Oath Keepers militia group over Jan. 6 riot
wire.summary: A judge has granted the Justice Department's bid to drop a landmark case against leaders of the Oath Keepers, as former prosecutors warn about the dangers of denying the violence of Jan. 6.

wire.title: Pakistan's ruling party leads in Kashmir vote despite boycott call by banned group
wire.summary: Candidates backed by twice-elected former Prime Minister Nawaz Sharif's Pakistan Muslim League-N party have won 24 of the 34 seats decided in the first two phases of voting, the election commission, said Wednesday.

wire.title: Under China's new 'unity' law, Tibetans fight to preserve language and culture
wire.summary: A 73-year-old retired nurse's decision to learn to write Tibetan language offers a glimpse into how some embrace their language and cultural identity in Tibet.

wire.title: Progressive Abdul El-Sayed wins Michigan's Democratic primary for Senate
wire.summary: El-Sayed, an epidemiologist, backs Medicare for all and decries corporate money in politics. He beat Rep. Haley Stevens, whose supporters said she would have had a better chance in the fall.

wire.title: U.S. missile stockpiles dwindle. And, FDA weighs approval of flu shots with mRNA tech
wire.summary: The U.S. Army's missile stockpile is dwindling and could take years to replenish. And, the Food and Drug Administration is deciding whether to approve a flu vaccine with mRNA technology.

wire.title: Russian missile and drone barrage in Ukrainian capital region kills 17
wire.summary: Russian missile and drone strikes on Kyiv and the surrounding region killed 17 people and wounded 44 others overnight into Wednesday, Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

wire.title: Progressives see biggest win yet in Michigan, while Trump flexes power over GOP
wire.summary: Progressives notched major wins in Michigan, while voters in Missouri and Washington rejected insurgent Democrats. Meanwhile, Trump continued to flex his influence over the Republican Party.

wire.title: Nicotine pouches can be marketed as 'lower risk' than cigarettes. Is that dangerous?
wire.summary: The FDA allowed some Zyn nicotine pouches to be marketed as "lower risk" than cigarettes. Public health experts agree they can help current smokers, but worry young people may become addicted.

wire.title: House Ethics Committee opens investigation into Ohio Republican Max Miller
wire.summary: The House Ethics Committee has opened an investigation into Rep. Max Miller, after the Ohio Republican asked for a probe of the domestic abuse allegations that have swirled around his reelection bid.

wire.title: Left-wing political outsider wins Democratic Senate primary in Michigan
wire.summary: Abdul El-Sayed, the son of Egyptian immigrants, would be the first Muslim US senator if elected in November.

wire.title: Drone carrying explosives found at German airport, police say
wire.summary: The drone was found near Ukrainian cargo planes before another object collided with a cargo aircraft in mid-air.

wire.title: Russia strike kills 21 as Ukraine says it needs more missile interceptors
wire.summary: The Russia defence ministry said it had struck logistics hubs and supply centres in Kyiv and the surrounding region.

wire.title: Why some scientists are thrilled that a SpaceX rocket has crashed into the Moon
wire.summary: While the collision was an accident, it is a unique scientific gift for planetary geologists that could provide important data for future space missions.

wire.title: UN rights chief alarmed by rise in Iran executions since March
wire.summary: Volker Türk says 56 people have been executed on national security-related charges, including 27 in cases linked to January's protests.

wire.title: Waste workers help winner find binned €1m lottery ticket in Italy
wire.summary: The player only realised they binned the life-changing ticket after family told them the numbers he played for years had been drawn.
